multivariate_market_coverage.note: Kalshi's CFB combo/parlay markets are DYNAMICALLY INSTANTIATED, not pre-listed per game. Live evidence: exactly three multivariate collections reference NCAAF events (KXMVESPORTSMULTIGAMEEXTENDED-R, KXMVECROSSCATEGORY-R, KXMVECROSSCATEGORY-SHARD1-R), each listing the same 1,018 NCAAF event tickers among 2,603 cross-sport legs, with size_min=2 and functional_description 'The resulting market will only resolve to YES if every associated market resolves to YES'. An instantiated combo appears under a synthetic hash-suffixed event (KXMVESPORTSMULTIGAMEEXTENDED-S20264E1F9411A8E) whose legs are named in custom_strike rather than under any single game's event. There is therefore NO endpoint that enumerates the combos available for one physical game, and this catalog does not claim to cover them. What it does report per game is which of that game's events Kalshi lists as combo-eligible legs.

fee.note: This is the documented TRADE FEE only (fee model, rounded up to $0.000001) -- NOT a net fee. Kalshi's net fee is trade fee + rounding fee - rebate, where the rounding fee, the rebate and the per-order fee accumulator all depend on the account's target balance precision ($0.0001 direct member, $0.01 non-direct) and on that order's fill sequence. None of those are knowable without credentials, so this public catalog does not estimate them.
fee.side_note: Buying YES executes at basis_yes_ask; buying NO executes at basis_no_ask. Each fee is computed from its own side's quoted ask -- the NO figure is never derived as 1 - yes_ask, because that complement is not a price anyone is offering. A null figure means that side had no quoted ask, not that it is free.

markets.rules_primary: If the College Football Playoff (CFP) has officially approved, through a binding decision by its authorized governing body or bodies, a fully adopted CFP championship format with exactly 24 participating teams and is confirmed by any of the Source Agencies after Issuance and before Dec 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
In order for the market to resolve to Yes, a Source Agency must report that the College Football Playoff (CFP) has officially approved a fully adopted championship format with exactly 24 participating teams. Both the binding approval and the qualifying news confirmation must occur after Issuance and before Dec 2, 2026. The decision must be official, binding action by the body or bodies authorized to adopt the CFP championship format. The approved format may first be implemented in a later season.

The number of distinct teams admitted to the CFP championship competition includes an opening or play-in round that is an integral part of that championship bracket. It does not count teams appearing only in separate qualification games, conference championship games, or unrelated bowls. Byes do not add teams. A format with fewer or more than 24 teams does not qualify.
